# Jeremiah 23 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 23:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "Woe to-the-shepherds destroying and-scattering the-sheep-of My-pasture!" declares YHWH. |
| LOGOS | "Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of My pasture!" declares the LORD. |
| PNEUMA | "How terrible it will be for the leaders of My people — the shepherds of My flock — for they have destroyed and scattered the very ones they were supposed to care for!" says the LORD. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
